text.t:
The ithos®️ wooden children's lamp, with its delicate rainbow silhouette, combines timeless design, cosy light and the charm of small details. Its warm white LED lighting creates a soft and comforting atmosphere, ideal for accompanying moments of reading, tranquillity and snuggliness before sleep, as well as being the perfect companion for a protected night for little ones' eyes.

During the day, it serves as a decorative piece that adds personality and tenderness to the children's bedroom. With careful finishes and hand-painted details, it integrates harmoniously into any setting, with soft woods and neutral tones.
Created to make rest moments even sweeter and more special.
